config.awesome_tridents.option.impaling_: Splash Mobs with a Water Bucket
config.awesome_tridents.option.riptide_b: Splash Yourself with a Water Bucket
config.awesome_tridents.tooltip.trident_: Controls whether the trident recipes added by this mod are available.
config.awesome_tridents.tooltip.throwing: Controls whether tridents can be thrown like a Drowned throws one.
config.awesome_tridents.tooltip.channeli: Controls whether this mod changes Channeling and lightning behavior.
Allows Channeling tridents to summon lightning outside thunderstorms.
Changes Channeling lightning to damage only the struck target.
Makes Channeling lightning ignore damage invulnerability frames without adding new ones.
Prevents Channeling lightning from clearing nearby item drops. If "Single-Target Lightning" is on, turning off this option alone has no effect.
Prevents Channeling lightning from igniting blocks at its impact area. If "Single-Target Lightning" is on, turning off this option alone has no effect.
Controls whether mobs struck by Channeling lightning drop cooked loot.
config.awesome_tridents.tooltip.impaling: Changes Impaling bonus damage to affect hostile targets touching water instead of aquatic mobs.
When a water bucket is in your hotbar or offhand, treats the hit target as wet to enable land-based Impaling bonus damage.
Enables this mod’s balance change that reduces Impaling bonus damage from +2.5 to +1.5 per level.
config.awesome_tridents.tooltip.riptide: Controls whether this mod changes Riptide behavior.
config.awesome_tridents.tooltip.riptide_: When a water bucket is in your hotbar or offhand, treats you as wet to enable land-based Riptide.
Dodges melee damage while you are flying with Riptide.
Improves Riptide collision checks to prevent passing through mobs. Strongly recommended if you use Riptide tridents to ram mobs!
Improves Riptide movement checks to prevent wriggling against the ground or walls. Strongly recommended if you use Riptide tridents to ram mobs!

neoforge.screen.mods.info.description.aw: The vanilla Trident is a textbook example of how *not* to design a weapon. It’s absurdly difficult to obtain, deals pathetic damage, and is severely limited in terms of enchantments - not to mention the risk of accidentally throwing it into the void, where it’s lost forever. "Why can't it actually be useful?" you wonder. So, you downloaded this mod - hoping it will finally fulfill all your dreams for what a Trident should be!
